notes.independent_reconstruction_test_verified: Read manifest_test.exs lines 142-172 directly. The 'matches an independently-reconstructed digest' test builds expected_input via raw Elixir binary literals (<<byte_size(...)::32>> <> field, for script_id 'script-1', sorted-deduped capabilities 'a' then 'b', then script_source) and calls :crypto.hash(:sha256, ...) |> Base.encode16(case: :lower) directly -- it never calls Manifest.compute_hash/2 or Manifest's private length_prefixed/1 to build the expected value, only to build the actual value under test. This is genuinely independent, not circular. Cross-checked against lib/letflow/engine/lua/manifest.ex's actual implementation (compute_hash/2 + private length_prefixed/1, lines 141-167) and its moduledoc's documented byte layout (lines 60-72): field order (script_id, then sorted+deduped capabilities, then script_source), 32-bit big-endian length prefix per field -- the test's reconstruction matches exactly.
